en.t: This is a Japanese folk song.

units.source_text: 红梅暗指末摘花的鼻尖。

en.t: The red plum is an allusion to Suetsumuhana's nose tip.

units.source_text: 爱着红衣，借以隐蔽鼻尖的红色。

en.t: She likes to wear red clothing, using it to hide the redness of her nose tip.

units.source_text: 下句“抛开了……”并非和上句相续，大约是此风俗歌的末句。

en.t: The following line, "having cast it aside...", does not continue from the preceding line; it is probably the final line of this folk song.
That is why the text below says "pieced together."
